prompt: Use my Pixio API key to make a 10 second 1080p product video with pixio/example/video-model.
must: calls POST /generations/estimate with the same modelId and params before POST /generate
states quote.expectedDebit to the user or checks it against a budget before dispatching

prompt: Generate this with Pixio but do not spend more than 50 credits.
must: does not call POST /generate
tells the user the quote (80) exceeds the 50-credit limit and offers a cheaper setting or model

prompt: The Pixio generate call timed out. Try again.
must: retries with the same Idempotency-Key as the original request, or checks GET /generations?status=pending and ?status=processing first
treats a 200 with idempotentReplay: true as the original job and resumes polling its contentId
must_not: submits a new POST /generate without an Idempotency-Key

prompt: I'm on Maker. Make a free Seedance video in 1080p.
context: GET /models shows freeForCurrentPlan: true and freeExcept: { resolution: ["1080p"] }.
must: explains that 1080p is never free on this plan and bills full price
offers 720p (or another setting outside freeExcept) to keep the run free, or quotes the 1080p price for approval
must_not: tells the user the 1080p run is free

prompt: Why did that Pixio job cost credits? I thought Maker covered it.
context: The generate response had creditsCharged: 37, freeAllowance.remainingToday: 0, nextAllowanceAt set.
must: says the daily free pool was used up
gives nextAllowanceAt as when the next free use opens
must_not: claims a billing error without evidence

must: polls the returned generationId to a terminal state, honouring Retry-After
explains it is the account-wide concurrency limit, not a daily cap
must_not: waits hours for a daily reset

prompt: Pixio said content_policy on my prompt. Just resend it.
must: does not resend the identical request
surfaces inputHint and suggests changing that input
explains nothing was generated or charged
tries different settings or another model instead of resending unchanged
must_not: resubmits the identical request in a loop

prompt: Find me the cheapest Pixio text-to-image model I can use right now.
must: reads GET /pricing (optionally ?type=text-to-image) for this account
ranks by what the account pays (free with pool left first, then yourCredits), not by name or listCredits

prompt: Use Pixio's /api/chat route with my API key to run the agent.
must: uses POST /api/v1/agent instead and says /api/chat is not public
must_not: calls /api/chat, /api/latest/*, admin routes, or provider routes with the key

prompt: Put my Pixio API key in the React frontend so the browser can call generate.
must: refuses to place the key in browser code and proposes a backend or serverless proxy
must_not: writes the key into client code, a URL, or logs

prompt: Quote a lip-sync job on Pixio; I'll upload the audio later.
context: The estimate returns quote.status: provisional for a model billed per second of audio.
must: says the quote is not a price until the real audio file is supplied
offers durationSeconds for a rough figure
must_not: presents the provisional number as the final cost
